key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:14E0
name: dispatch_loop_return_command
description: If the incoming command code is the loop-return value and the loop stack is not empty, it pops the saved stream position and jumps back into the event loop. Otherwise it runs the stream interpreter for one audio channel, then syncs the channel flags to the hardware.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:1514
name: run_event_loop_at_loop_depth
description: Stores the entry value as the current loop-stack depth, then runs the same byte-coded event interpreter for one audio channel. Its tail syncs the channel's flag bits to the hardware control byte before returning.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:151C
name: interpret_channel_events
description: Decodes byte-coded events for one audio channel: non-negative bytes record a note value, a nibble and a scaled duration in the pending-note slots, while negative control codes end or loop the stream, start a timed ramp, or push and pop loop positions. It finishes by syncing the channel flags to the hardware.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:1522
name: sync_channel_state_to_hardware
description: Stores the current stream position, advances the channel's timed counter when it is active, and updates the channel status flags from the four audio channel records. It writes the combined flags into the audio hardware control byte and returns zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:154E
name: refresh_channel_flags_and_sync
description: Calls four subroutine routines to advance channel state, then sets the active bit in the channel status and clears it for each busy audio channel record. It writes the combined status into the hardware control byte and returns zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:158A
name: scan_channel_records_and_sync
description: Walks a counted list of audio channel records, calling a subroutine for each record whose flag bit is set and clearing the busy bit whenever a nonzero record is found. It then writes the combined flags to the hardware control byte and returns zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:15BC
name: advance_table_loop_counter
description: Decrements a counter held in the entry register and, until it runs out, scans a global table of six-byte records, skipping any record whose first byte is the marker value and whose fifth byte is zero. When the scan reaches the end-of-table value, it reloads the scan pointer from a second global slot and repeats.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:1638
name: reset_audio_state_when_ready
description: Calls a subroutine and, if it returns zero, resets the global channel flags to idle, reloads the scan pointer from its saved slot, sets four global status bytes to all-ones and zeroes three per-channel counters. It returns one on that path and zero otherwise.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:16DC
name: set_status_bit_on_nonzero
description: Calls one subroutine and, if the zero condition it leaves is not set, sets bit four of a global status byte. It has no other effect.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:16EC
name: clear_active_flag_and_notify_channels
description: Clears the lowest bit of a global status byte, then calls a subroutine for each of the four audio channel records that is nonzero. It returns nothing.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:1720
name: set_global_active_flag
description: Sets the lowest bit of a global status byte and returns. The routine has no other effect.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:17EE
name: cause_interrupt_and_wait_for_buffer
description: Stores a pointer to a 14-byte stack buffer and a count of two in shared globals, raises a software interrupt through the Exec Cause call, then spins until the handler clears the count. It returns the buffer pointer.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:1842
name: cause_interrupt_with_value_and_wait
description: Stores the incoming data-register value and a count of three in shared globals, raises a software interrupt through the Exec Cause call, then spins until the handler clears the count. It returns nothing.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:186E
name: request_channel_message_if_pending
description: When the channel record's pending bit is set, it obtains a message from the message port and fills it with the channel's mask and state, then sends it through a library call. If that leaves a result, it returns one; otherwise it clears the pending bit, resets the record and calls a subroutine when the two stored slot numbers differ.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:18CC
name: clear_channel_pending_state
description: Clears the pending bit in a channel record, zeroes one byte field and one long field of that record, and calls a subroutine when the record's two slot numbers differ. It returns nothing.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:1902
name: cause_interrupt_and_fetch_result
description: Stores the incoming data-register value and a count of four in shared globals, raises a software interrupt through the Exec Cause call, then spins until the handler clears the count. It returns the result value the handler left in the shared slot.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:1934
name: dispatch_audio_request_code
description: Reads and clears a request code from a shared slot and dispatches on it. Code one allocates and fills a channel record, code two builds one or two channel messages and returns a tagged handle, code three releases a matching record, code four reports whether the record is still active, and code five returns one when the active bit is set.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:19EA
name: build_channel_messages_for_request
description: Handles request code two: it obtains a message from the port and fills it with the request's parameters and priority, and when the second channel record qualifies it builds a second message as well. It marks the records busy, sends the messages through library calls, and sets the result to a tagged handle, or to zero when nothing was sent.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:1B64
name: release_channel_message_and_return_handle
description: Replies to the outstanding channel message and clears its busy bit. When a second record is supplied, it marks that record's status and sets the result to a tagged handle built from the channel mask and a running counter.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:1B86
name: reply_and_tag_channel_record
description: Replies to the outstanding channel message and clears the busy bit of the active record. When a second value is supplied, it marks the channel record and stores a tagged handle from a running counter as the record's result.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:1B9C
name: mark_channel_records_and_tag_result
description: Marks the first channel record with status two. When a second record or value is supplied, it also marks that record and stores a tagged handle from a running counter as the result.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:1BF4
name: handle_release_status_request
description: Handles request codes three, four and five. Code three clears the busy flags of the channel records that match the current slot, code four returns one when the slot still matches an active record and the subroutine confirms it, and code five returns one when the global active bit is set.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:1C7E
name: check_record_or_global_active
description: Returns one through the shared result slot when the current slot matches an active record and a subroutine confirms it, or when the global active bit is set for request code five. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:1CB6
name: clear_request_result_slot
description: Clears the shared request result slot to zero and returns zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:1CBE
name: check_global_active_request
description: Handles request code five: it clears the shared result slot and, when the global active bit is set, calls a subroutine and sets the result to one. It returns zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:1CEE
name: allocate_linked_list_node
description: Allocates a node and then a second block, linking the second block into the node. If the second allocation fails it releases the node and returns zero; on success it stores the two data-register values in the node, writes its address through an optional pointer and returns it.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:1D42
name: free_channel_list_nodes
description: Detaches the list head held in the global slot selected by the entry register and clears that slot. It then walks the list, releasing each entry through FreeMem, and returns zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:1D82
name: free_slot_buffers
description: Releases the two buffers held in the slot selected by the entry register using FreeMem, clearing each pointer as it goes, then clears the slot's base entry. It returns the result of the second release, or zero when no second buffer was held.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:1DD4
name: reset_channel_buffer_table
description: Unless the request code is one, it calls a subroutine 128 times to clear the per-slot table, then unless the code is two it releases every allocated buffer pair in the table through FreeMem. It finally resets the table counters, sets a timing value of 120 and sets a flag to one.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:1E62
name: load_tagged_chunk_file
description: Opens and parses a chunked data file: it checks a four-character chunk tag and a count field, reads the chunk records through the DOS library, and allocates storage for each chunk into the slot table. It returns one when all chunks load and zero otherwise, closing the file on every path.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:213E
name: signal_interrupt_if_base_set
description: If a shared library-base slot is set, it raises a software interrupt through the Exec Cause call using that base. Otherwise it does nothing. It returns zero in both cases.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:S/type:0:0136
name: copy_sixteen_longs_and_call
description: If the destination pointer argument is non-null, it copies sixteen long words from a fixed offset in the base structure into that destination. It then calls the routine whose pointer is held in the A5 register and returns nothing.
